Vīṇakavi
one of the names ment. in the Bhojaprabandha (p. 73 of Calcutta edn., 1883), see Poona Ori. X. p. 67 fn.

Vīṇayannasudhī

-Yajñaśāstrārthanirṇaya. Mysore I. 446 (a. says Veṅkaṭeśvara). III. p. 14. Mysore N. D. XI. 38320. Extr. p. 256. 38321.

Vīṇā

See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 2996.

Vīṇāḍamarukavādya
Kavīndrācārya 2125.

Vīṇātantra
vaidika. ment. in Śivatattvaratnākara, p. 4 (edn. Madras, 1927); in Oxf. 109a; in Tarkaratna of Kṛṣṇa Vidyāvāgīśa, IO. 2573.
Kavīndrācārya 1762.

Vīṇādevīmantravidhi
Mysore N. D. XVI. ii. 50928-29. [Page257-a.

Vīṇādhārīkṣaṇa
bharataśāstra. Mysore N. D. VIII. 28864.

Vīṇāpāṇistuti
in 5 v.. (beg. zaraNaM karavANi zarmadate caraNaM …).
Pt.. in Br. St. Ratnākara, p. 343, Pandita Pustakalaya, Kashi, 1950.

Vīṇāpāda
a descendant of Virūpa, described a. a Kṣatriya prince of Ghahura who was fond of the Vīṇā, wrote 3 works on Vajraḍākinī an. Tantric initiation a. well a. one Dohā (no. 17) given in the Caryācaryaviniścaya. His work exists only in Tibetan.
See Cordier p. 238; also Buddhist Tantric Literature of Bengal, NIA. I. p. 23.
-Guhyābhiṣekaprakriyā. Bud. Cordier II. p. 84.
-Vajraḍākinīniṣpannakrama. Bud. Cordier II. p. 238. Suzuki, Otani 3221.

Vīṇāprapāṭhaka
music. Baroda II. 5351.

Vīṇāmantra
Mysore N. D. XVI. ii. 50927.

Vīṇālakṣaṇa
music. by Parameśvara. Baroda II. 10010 (b).

Vīṇāvatī
drama. a. example for uparūpaka.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. sns. 563. 877; also V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛ. Pra., p. 553. [Page257-b]

Vīṇāvādanaprakāra
music. SB. New D.. XII. ii. 109056 (inc.). (with tāla an. svara).

Vīṇāvādinīmantra
from Pañcāgamāstra of Surendrasaṃhitā. TD. XX. Sup. no. 953 (c6) (in a. collection).

Vīṇāvāsavadatta(ttā)
nāṭaka. or Vatsarājacarita. in 8 acts. the drama having for its plot the marraiage of Vāsavadattā an. Vatsarāja. Adyar D. V. 1558 (inc.). Br. Mus. II. 419. 425. Deśamaṅgalam 605. 608-10. MT. 2784 (inc.). Trav. Uni. L-803-B (inc.). T-1179 (inc.).
See V. Raghavan, Bhoja's Śṛ. Pra. p.. 801. 828.
Pt.. (1) Act. I-IV. ed. by C. Kunhan Raja, JOR, Madras, 1927, 1931 (reprint); (2) Act VII. ibid, 1936; (3) Act. V-VI. ed. by C. Kunhan Raja, Bhāratīya Vidyā, Bombay, 1945.
-by Śūdraka.
See S. N. Dasgupta, HSL. Classical Period, Vol. I. p. 761.

Vīṇāvāsavadattakathā
based on the story of the text mentioned above. SSES. 858.
Pt.. ed. by K. V. Sarma, VVRI. Hoshiarpur, 1971.

Vīṇāśikha
Bṛhatsūcī, Nepal IV. ii. p. 146.

Vīṇāśikhottara
or Vīṇādya tantra. one of the 64 tantra ment. in Vāmakeśvarīmata, Kas. Texts, 66, p. 17. [Page258-a.

Vīṇāśikhottara
śaiva. Upāgama in Yogaja āgama. See List in Kāmikā.

Vīṇāśyāmalāmantra
mantra. MD. 7248-49. 16533. Mysore N. D. XVI. ii. 50930.

Vīṇāṣṭaka
stotra. by Rāja Varman (1863-1918. A. D.), son of Vāsudevan Nambutiri of Oṇamturutti Paṭṭa family.
See K. K. Raja, CKSL., p. 257.

Vīṇāmohopākhyāna
vedānta. Burnell 95b. TD. 23919.
